title: nexu-io/html-video: agent-driven HTML/CSS to local MP4
summary: Apache-2.0 monorepo that turns prompts, links, or repos into MP4 videos by generating per-frame HTML and rendering locally via Hyperframes (headless Chromium + ffmpeg). Ships a studio CLI, 21 templates, and optional MiniMax soundtrack; no per-render cloud fee.
question_it_answers: How can coding agents render HTML/CSS storyboards into MP4 on a laptop without a video model?

claims.text: Default render path is Hyperframes headless Chromium plus ffmpeg to MP4.
claims.evidence: default engine is Hyperframes (headless Chromium + ffmpeg)
claims.subject: code-motion-graphics

claims.text: Repo documents 14 supported coding agents and 21 motion templates.
claims.evidence:
**14 coding agents** supported (Open Design, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.)
- **21 templates** (data viz, kinetic type, cinematic frames)
